profile.name: Janna Safran
profile.meta_description: AI Conversation Designer working at the intersection of healthcare, human behavior, and AI systems. I design the conversations, decision logic, and safeguards behind conversational AI, grounded in behavioral science, public health, and mixed-methods research.

hero.headline: I design the behavior behind AI conversations, from how a system responds to the boundaries that shape what it should and shouldn't do.
hero.subhead: My philosophy is simple: people first, build second, iterate frequently. I combine research, behavioral science, and systems thinking to design around how people think, decide, and act.
